note: Effective TN = skill/attribute TN - tier penalty. Roll d20 <= Effective TN to succeed. Natural 1 / 20 always add a narrative consequence (GM decides). Tiers below Routine have a negative penalty: they raise the TN (decision 78) — help from others, good tools, time, an inside contact; the GM picks the step, no extra rule.

tiers.name: Very easy
tiers.example: A whole crew working together, the right gear and all the time needed: a roll only for what could still go wrong.

tiers.name: Easy
tiers.example: Two or three helping each other (a leg-up over a wall), good tools for the job, no pressure.

tiers.name: Favourable
tiers.example: Someone helps, a useful tool or a tip from a contact, a moment to prepare.

tiers.name: Routine
tiers.example: Clear line of sight, stable footing, standard net access, low stress.

tiers.name: Challenging
tiers.example: Partial cover, light rain or fog, basic civilian encryption, minor time pressure.

tiers.name: Hard
tiers.example: Heavy rain, low light, commercial firewalls, firing while moving into cover.

tiers.name: Severe
tiers.example: Full cover, zero visibility or heavy smoke, military-grade encryption, active suppression.

tiers.name: Extreme
tiers.example: Dangling from a moving aircraft, active thermal lockout, firing blind into cover.

tiers.name: Nightmare
tiers.example: Complex actions during a System Hard Reboot, cracking a megacorp core under fire.
